HubSpot Data Dictionary

The canonical reference for HubSpot contact fields, workflows, and lists at Healthie. Written for RevOps analysts and SFDC admins. All field names link to HubSpot settings; all workflows and lists link directly to HubSpot.

⚠ Critical rules before writing to any field
  • hs_marketable_status — never set directly. Use the "Set Marketing Contact Status" workflow action only.
  • currently_in_lead_nurture — never set manually. Written and cleared by workflows only.
  • current_plan__c — never edit in HubSpot. All changes must originate in Salesforce.
  • specialty_ii — use this (not the legacy free-text "specialty" field) for all specialty segmentation.

Lifecycle & Qualification

3 fields 👤 RevOps + Marketing
Tracks where a contact sits in the buyer journey. Used by Marketing to qualify leads and Sales to prioritize outreach. Synced bidirectionally with Salesforce.
API Field NameLabelTypeFill RateDefinition & NotesActive ValuesHow PopulatedSFDC FieldWritable
lifecyclestage★ KEYLifecycle StageEnumeration
100%
The canonical stage of a contact in the revenue funnel. Custom Healthie stages: Free Trial and Not Qualified. Progresses forward via automation; regressing requires explicit workflow or manual override.
Do not set backward manually — use a deliberate workflow action.
Lead → Marketing Qualified Lead → Sales Accepted Lead → Opportunity → Free Trial → Customer → Not QualifiedHubSpot (auto + workflow + manual)Lead / Contact StageEDITABLE

77%

Read-only in HubSpot. All edits originate in Salesforce.

Marketing Eligibility & Suppression

3 fields 👤 Marketing (Josh)
Fields that gate whether a contact can receive marketing emails. Writing to these incorrectly can suppress large audiences or cause double-enrollment.
API Field NameLabelTypeFill RateDefinition & NotesActive ValuesHow PopulatedSFDC FieldWritable
hs_marketable_status★ KEYMarketing Contact StatusBoolean
100%
Master gate for email sends. A contact must be 'Marketing contact' to receive marketing emails. Set via the 'Set Marketing Contact Status' workflow action (type 0-31).
⚠ NEVER set manually — use the dedicated workflow action only. Contacts created via import default to non-marketing.
Marketing contact (true) / Non-marketing contact (false)HubSpot (workflow-managed)—READ ONLY
currently_in_lead_nurture★ KEYCurrently in Lead NurtureBoolean
0%
Cross-workflow suppression flag. Set to Yes at nurture workflow start; cleared at completion. Prevents double-enrollment — workflows check this at entry and exit immediately if Yes.
⚠ DO NOT set manually. If a contact is stuck at Yes after their workflow ended, the completion/clear step may not have fired. Workflows using this flag: Solo WS (1808833320), Group WS (1812752678), PP Trial Onboarding (525591918), PP Calculator 2+ (1681357102), PP Calculator Solo (1682252214).
Yes / NoWorkflow-managed—READ ONLY
active_discussionActive DiscussionBoolean
0%
Set when a contact is in active BD outreach. Suppresses contact from ALL marketing workflows until cleared.
BD team owns set/clear. Marketing should check this before building campaigns that overlap with sales-active contacts.
Yes / NoBD team (manual)—EDITABLE

DG: EMS: PP Re-engagement — In or Out
ID: 1812743196
▸ Trigger & criteria
Trigger: Contact is a member of List 2930 (11-Month Lapsed Engager: last open > 330 days AND Marketing Contact = true AND last email send < 330 days).
Re-engagement workflow — the ongoing data hygiene system. Fires as contacts cross the 11-month no-open threshold on a rolling basis. Sends one email: 'Still want to hear from us?' with a YES link to go.gethealthie.com/stay-subscribed. 14-day wait. If clicked → contact stays Marketing Contact. If no click → contact set to Non-Marketing Contact. Runs continuously, no end date.
  • Send re-engagement email
  • Wait 14 days
  • Branch: Clicked YES → remains Marketing Contact, clear nurture flag
  • Branch: No click → Set Marketing Contact = Non-Marketing Contact

HVA (High Value Action) trial conversion nurture. Targets the highest-intent non-converting trialists — those who engaged with the in-app onboarding tour but haven't upgraded. 3-email sequence over 13 days with escalating CTAs: discount offer → book a call → upgrade push.
  • Email 1 — Day 3: Discount offer (limited time)
  • Email 2 — Day 8: Human-touch book-a-call CTA
  • Email 3 — Day 13: Direct upgrade push
  • Exit goal: current_plan__c becomes a paid plan

RevOps Partnership
HubSpot + Salesforce — One Unified Data Layer
This data dictionary is the HubSpot half of Healthie's go-to-market data layer. The SFDC column in every field table maps directly to the corresponding Salesforce field. The goal: pair this with the Salesforce data dictionary so that Revenue Operations has a single unified reference across both systems — no more "which system is right?"
HubSpot Owner
Josh Druck
Marketing Operations
SFDC / RevOps Owner
Bill
Revenue Operations
Proposed Cadence
Monthly 30-min sync
Field changes · new integrations · data quality

Workflow Naming Conventions

Prefix determines category — enforced across all 260 workflows
CategoryPrefixExampleOwner
Nurture SeriesDG: EMS:DG: EMS: Solo Welcome SeriesMarketing Ops (Josh)
Marketing CampaignsDG: EM:DG: EM: Meta Ebook Follow-UpMarketing Ops (Josh)
WebinarsWBN:WBN: BTA May 15 — RegistrationMarketing Ops (Josh)
Content DownloadsEB:EB: Dietitian Ebook — Download ConfirmMarketing Ops (Josh)
Customer MarketingCM:CM: Plus Trial Onboarding Day 3Marketing Ops (Josh)
SFDC OperationsSFDC:SFDC Campaign — ACA 2026 AttendeesRevOps (Bill)
Events/ConferencesTS:TS: ACA 2026 — Booth Attendee NurtureMarketing Ops (Josh)
NotificationsSLACK: / NOTIF:SLACK: New Enterprise Lead AlertMarketing Ops (Josh)
Templates[TEMPLATE]DG: BTA Webinar [TEMPLATE]Marketing Ops (Josh)
Rule: Before creating any workflow, confirm the correct prefix for its category. Workflows without a recognized prefix cannot be categorized by the data dictionary or the AI List Health Report.

Ownership & Authority

Who can create, edit, and retire each data layer
AreaOwnerCan CreateCan EditCan Retire / Delete
HubSpot contact propertiesMarketing Ops (Josh)Marketing OpsRevOps sign-off requiredMarketing Ops
SFDC-synced fields (read HubSpot)RevOps (Bill)SFDC onlySFDC onlyRevOps (Bill)
Workflow creationMarketing Ops (Josh)Marketing OpsMarketing OpsMarketing Ops — disable first, 30-day hold
List creationMarketing Ops (Josh)Marketing OpsMarketing OpsMarketing Ops
Suppression field writesWorkflows onlyWorkflow actionWorkflow actionMarketing Ops
SFDC campaign creationRevOps (Bill)SFDCSFDCRevOps (Bill)
UTM naming conventionMarketing Ops (Josh)Marketing OpsMarketing OpsMarketing Ops
Marketing Contact StatusWorkflows onlyWF action onlyWF action onlyNever delete — workflow-managed
Hard rules: Never manually write to hs_marketable_status or currently_in_lead_nurture — use workflow actions only. Never edit current_plan__c or any SFDC-sourced field in HubSpot — changes must originate in Salesforce.

Salesforce ↔ HubSpot Field Sync

Which system wins on conflict — configured per field in the HubSpot integration settings
View Live Field Mappings ↗
Prefer SFDC
Salesforce is the source of truth. If both systems have a value and they conflict, SFDC wins. HubSpot updates to match.
Use for: plan data, SFDC-owned contact status, revenue fields
Prefer HubSpot
HubSpot is the source of truth. If both systems conflict, HubSpot wins. SFDC updates to match.
Use for: marketing fields, UTM data, HubSpot-native lifecycle stage
Bi-Directional
Most recent update wins. Either system can write. Requires careful coordination — conflicts are resolved by timestamp.
Use for: shared fields where both teams actively update (e.g. contact name, email)
The SFDC Field column in the Fields tab above shows which HubSpot properties have a corresponding Salesforce field. Fields marked READ ONLY in HubSpot are Prefer SFDC — they can only be updated from Salesforce. Any new sync configuration should be agreed between Josh (HubSpot) and Bill (RevOps/SFDC) before enabling.

Audit Cadence

Scheduled reviews that keep the data layer clean and current
FrequencyWhatHowWho
WeeklyAI List Health ReportAuto-runs every Monday 9am — diffs all 98+ active lists, flags size anomalies, publishes to go.gethealthie.com/peapod-list-health. Calendar alert fires if action needed.Automated (Marketing Ops)
MonthlyInactive workflow reviewAny workflow with status = OFF for 90+ days is a retirement candidate. Disable → 30-day hold → delete. Document retirement reason in Journey Reference.Marketing Ops (Josh)
QuarterlyData dictionary refreshRe-run gen_hubspot_data_dictionary.py to update fill rates, workflow count, list count. Review deprecated properties. Add new fields. Align with Bill on SFDC changes.Marketing Ops + RevOps (Bill)
Ad-hocNew SFDC field → HubSpot syncAny new SFDC field that needs a HubSpot counterpart: align naming with Bill before creating. Add to dictionary on creation. Do not create HubSpot-only properties that duplicate SFDC fields.Marketing Ops + RevOps (Bill)
Ad-hocNew workflow or listCheck naming convention. Test on sample list (≥10 contacts) before enabling. Add to Journey Reference within 48 hours of go-live.Marketing Ops (Josh)

Change Process

How changes move from idea to production
New Workflow
  1. Confirm naming prefix for category
  2. Build and test on sample list (≥10 contacts)
  3. Enable — monitor enrollment for 24 hours
  4. Add to Journey Reference within 48 hours
New Contact Property
  1. Check if field exists in SFDC (align with Bill first)
  2. Agree on naming convention with RevOps
  3. Create in HubSpot — add fill-rate tracking if needed
  4. Add to data dictionary in relevant section
Retire a Workflow
  1. Set status to OFF (never delete immediately)
  2. 30-day hold — confirm no active contacts enrolled
  3. Delete with a note in Journey Reference
  4. Update any list references or suppression logic
New SFDC → HubSpot Field Sync
  1. RevOps (Bill) creates/confirms SFDC field
  2. Agree on HubSpot field name — match SFDC naming
  3. Configure sync direction (bi-directional vs read-only)
  4. Add to data dictionary with SFDC column populated
Maintained by Marketing Operations  ·  Journey Reference  ·  Questions? #rev-ops in Slack
